about: the duck sitting, captured from the real duck 2026-11-25 (twin.py --remote --save-pose; grav from its IMU). The head rest (neck, head pitch) is the raised pose the user set by hand; head mode raises the head to it when it starts, and the emotions move around it. crouch: the neck and head pitch as it first sat, the furthest forward the neck may go. grav: the IMU tilt (grav_imu) turned 8.5 deg forward until the feet touch the floor, as the duck sits (the user, 2026-11-25). 2026-11-25 later: raising the rest 10-20 deg higher tipped the duck over backwards; back to the pose the user first set; then the head pitch 20 deg further forward (the face sat tilted up, the user); then the neck 10 deg further forward, the face kept (angry tipped it over backwards); then back to the neck -114 deg, head pitch -21 deg the user set (the sitting moves are half size and smoothed now, angry smaller still)
